versions.content: ⌊ DRAFT g The diagnostic data element return control to ECU for a SwCluCDcmProxyDiagnosticData is enabled, if: • SwCluCDcmProxyDataRef references a DcmDspData AND • the corresponding DcmDspDid has a DcmDspDidControl configured in its re- lated DcmDspDidInfo AND • the parameter DcmDspDidFreezeCurrentState is set to true .
